headlines.title: 'We took on a machine': Abdul El-Sayed thanks supporters after primary victory
headlines.description: Abdul El-Sayed held a press conference to thank his family and supporters after winning Michigan's Democratic Senate primary. NBC News' Shaquille Brewster reports on the race in Michigan and who El-Sayed will be facing in November.

headlines.title: Trump-backed John James wins Michigan’s GOP primary for governor
headlines.description: Rep. John James has won Michigan’s Republican nomination for governor, NBC News projects.

headlines.title: New CDC director is confirmed, giving agency its first permanent leader in a year
headlines.description: The Senate confirmed Dr. Erica Schwartz to lead the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, making her the agency’s first permanent director in more than a year.

headlines.title: Chilling video shows drone ‘safari’ attack
headlines.description: Ukraine said a Russian drone chased a vegetable vendor before exploding. Incredibly, the man survived. NBC News’ Keir Simmons reports.

headlines.title: Jason Sudeikis Shares What to Expect From ‘Ted Lasso’ Season 4
headlines.description: “Ted Lasso” creator and star Jason Sudeikis joins TODAY to chat about the return of the beloved series for Season Four and shares what fans can expect with the titular character invited back to coach A.F.C. Richmond’s new women’s football league. He also shares the backstory to his famous dance on the series that originally helped land him a role as a “Saturday Night Live” cast member.

headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.

headlines.title: Progressives had another big primary night – with a notable exception: From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: Welcome to From the Politics Desk, a daily newsletter that brings you the NBC News Politics team’s latest reporting and analysis from the White House, Capitol Hill and the campaign trail.

headlines.title: Florida pastor accused of having sex with 14-year-old boy while hiding HIV diagnosis
headlines.description: “Dope-smoking pedophile preacher” Timothy Chaneyfield had sex with an underage boy without telling them he was HIV positive, Florida officials say.

headlines.title: 3 people killed, including suspect, in North Carolina shooting
headlines.description: A shooting Wednesday at a home in North Carolina left three people dead, including the suspect, and another person injured, authorities said.

headlines.title: Millions of eggs have been recalled due to Salmonella contamination — here’s how to stay safe
headlines.description: A multistate salmonella outbreak linked to eggs has sickened nearly one hundred people. Learn the symptoms, risks, and simple steps to protect your family from infection.

headlines.title: The best rolling backpacks for school, travel and work
headlines.description: We rounded up the best rolling backpacks with multiple compartments to distribute the weight evenly. Shop rolling backpacks from Pottery Barn, Jansport, Rockland and more.
